product_constraint: MTP committed Decode 1.5x–3x same-request non-MTP, exact target state/logits/output, drafts 2/3 and paired Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total.

downward_budget.qualification: Graph span includes projections, MLP, recurrence and inner gaps; not a measured Conv latency. No isolated speedup forecast.

lineage: v81 carried GDN state across token rows and left Conv unchanged; it was removed. This keeps original per-token GDN schedule and state scratch, eliminating Conv producer and D2D snapshot boundaries inside each call. No row-state reuse or graph-granularity revival.
equivalence_ledger: For each channel use original four ascending FP32 fmaf operations from +0, original convolution/(1+exp(-convolution)), then encode/decode BF16 before GDN consumption.
Q/K values are recomputed in three value-head CTAs. Only the first CTA of each triple writes Q/K history; each value head uniquely writes its own V history. No multiple-writer race.
Conv reads canonical history for row zero or prior immutable prefix thereafter; writes current immutable prefix, never its own input. Raw QKV remains immutable for whole call.
Every GDN FMA/reduction, rounded state and unrounded current output, BF16 raw output and norm/gate remain original; no cross-token reassociation.
Original canonical full prefix restoration still precedes each observer. Speculative canonical Conv is no longer mutated and cannot be observed until commit. All full prefix bytes must match scalar.
Extra Q/K Conv math replaces intermediate publication/read, separate kernel and snapshot copy; new private CUDA code only, no new owner/arena/allocation or production dispatch.
validation: Complete synthetic output/state/Conv/guard and Graph comparisons, root race/sync checks, complete P65 prefix and transaction/cancel/failure admission, immediate d2 API P65/8K/40K; short >3% regression or nonpositive 8K stops. Useful whole direction admits d3. Neutral whole path removes.
retention_expiry: One full API return selects removal or dependency through next complete verifier architecture return/archival; no production or full-goal claim.
